name: EWOS — Early Warning Operating System
platform_notes: Runs on Lovable (TanStack Start + Lovable Cloud). Monorepo packages from the BRD map to in-repo folders: app-web=src/routes+components, ui-lib=src/components/ewos, plugin-sdk=src/sdk, backend-api=server functions + api routes, data=Cloud migrations, docs=docs/.
design_tokens: src/design/tokens.json (source of truth mirrored in src/styles.css)

backlog.title: Project manifest + checkpoint mechanism
backlog.acceptance_criteria: project_manifest.json exists at repo root; docs/CONTRIBUTING.md documents update rules; every AI run reads and appends to it.

backlog.title: Design system + tokens (dark ops console)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: All colors defined as oklch semantic tokens incl. 4-level hazard severity scale; no hardcoded color classes in components; tokens exported to src/design/tokens.json.

backlog.title: Workspace shell (3-column, map-first)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Collapsible left nav, MapLibre center canvas, resizable right contextual panel, top bar with search, bottom operations dock; keyboard shortcuts [ ] and Cmd/Ctrl+K.

backlog.title: GIS engine v0 (MapLibre + OSM)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Dark basemap + satellite toggle, layer visibility + opacity controls, GeoJSON hazard polygons, gauge markers, admin boundaries.

backlog.title: Database schema v1 (PostGIS, org-scoped)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: organizations, user_roles, modules, module_installs, events (GIST index), notifications, river_gauges, gauge_readings, admin_boundaries; RLS on all tables; seed data for demo org.

backlog.title: Event bus v1 + canonical envelope
backlog.acceptance_criteria: events table with topic + semver schema_version; realtime feed to UI; JSON Schemas for FloodAlertIssued and VegetationStressHigh.

backlog.title: Plugin SDK skeleton
backlog.acceptance_criteria: defineHazardApp() with lifecycle hooks, panel + map layer registration, event publish/subscribe types; documented in docs/sdk.md.

backlog.title: Flood Module (canonical HazardApp)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Registered via SDK; gauge panel with live readings; server-side risk scan ingests a reading, classifies severity, publishes FloodAlertIssued with GeoJSON polygon; alert appears in feed + map.

backlog.title: AI Decision Assistant v0
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Floating action button opens chat panel; Explain/Act mode toggle; streaming responses via Lovable AI; server-side prompt includes org + live event context.

backlog.title: Capability Store v0
backlog.acceptance_criteria: /store lists modules from DB with version, publisher, permissions, privacy classification, install state.

backlog.title: Organization Manager UI + auth (login, org roles)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Email+Google sign-in; org switcher functional; role-gated module management; RLS tightened (remove demo anon write policies).
backlog.progress: Email + Google sign-in live at /auth; AuthGate wraps workspace and store; new sign-ups auto-provisioned into Demo Org as viewer via handle_new_user trigger; profiles table added; demo anon INSERT policies replaced with org-member scoped policies on events/notifications/gauge_readings. Remaining: role-gated module install UI + multi-org switcher UX.

backlog.title: Notification channels (in-app feed + WhatsApp/SMS adapters stubbed)
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Notification engine dispatch table; channel adapter interface; in-app delivery working; WhatsApp/SMS behind secrets.

backlog.title: Timeline slider for time-series hazard layers
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Scrub events/readings over time on map.

backlog.title: Geofencing + polygon drawing tools
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Draw/edit polygons, save as boundaries, use as alert geofences.

backlog.title: Event chain demo: DroughtIndex→VegetationStressHigh→WildfireRiskUpdate→AgricultureImpact→CommunityAlert
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Chained subscriptions produce downstream events visible in feed with lineage.

backlog.title: AI Act mode: prefilled report templates + recommended actions execution
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Assistant can open prefilled alert drafts and trigger notification requests with human confirmation.

backlog.title: Marketplace publishing flow + HazardApp author checklist
backlog.acceptance_criteria: Module submission metadata, permission review, QA checklist per docs/sdk.md.

open_issues.note: Resolved 2026-07-15: anon INSERT policies on events/gauge_readings/notifications dropped; writes now require an authenticated org member (is_org_member).
DB linter flags PostGIS system objects (spatial_ref_sys RLS, extension in public, PostGIS SECURITY DEFINER fns). Inherent to PostGIS; revisit before production.

roadmap.phase_1: Platform Foundation (Sprints 1-2): shell, design system, schema, event bus, SDK, Flood Module, auth + org manager
roadmap.phase_2: GIS + Notifications depth (Sprint 3): drawing tools, timeline, exports, channel adapters
roadmap.phase_3: Interoperability (Sprint 3-4): event chain flows, module lineage
roadmap.phase_4: AI Orchestration (Sprint 4-5): Act mode, decision playbooks, AI-generated sitreps
roadmap.phase_5: Marketplace GA: third-party publishing, review pipeline
roadmap.phase_7: Federation: cross-org event sharing, regional early-warning mesh
